# llm-d Native AI Gateway Demo Transcript

**This file is auto-generated by the self-narrated demo scripts.**

To regenerate, run each demo script individually:

```bash
cd demo/llm-d-praxis

# Run all demos sequentially
bash scripts/demo1/run-static-model-aware.sh
bash scripts/demo2/run-load-aware.sh
bash scripts/demo3/run-inferencepool-discovery.sh
bash scripts/demo4/run-gateway-api.sh
bash scripts/demo5/run-prefix-cache.sh
bash scripts/demo6/run-saturation.sh
bash scripts/demo7/run-pd-disaggregation.sh
bash scripts/demo8/run-model-rewrite.sh
bash scripts/demo9/run-inference-objective.sh
```

Each script cleans up the previous demo, applies its manifests, waits for
pods, runs the test, validates with verbose logs, and cleans up port
forwarding on exit. Scripts can be run in any order.

## Prerequisites

- KIND cluster running with Praxis and llm-d-inference-sim images loaded
- See [deploy.md](deploy.md) for full setup instructions

## Demo Script Features

Each self-narrated script provides:

- **Colored headers** for section separation
- **Automatic cleanup** of previous demo resources
- **Pod readiness and DNS wait** before testing
- **Acceptance proof** referencing the relevant `cargo test` commands
- **Verbose log validation** proving which backend received requests
- **Port-forward management** with automatic teardown
